bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using multiple-choice stereotype questions from the BBQ benchmark to measure reliance on stereotypes, and via the HolisticBias dataset by scoring the toxicity of model-generated responses to prompts mentioning physical or medical disabilities.
Evaluated using the BBQ benchmark by measuring bias scores in multiple-choice question answering to determine if the model relies on religious stereotypes to resolve ambiguous contexts.

Evaluated via the BBQ benchmark for multiple-choice stereotype resolution and the HolisticBias dataset by measuring the toxicity of generated responses to conversational prompts mentioning gender and gender identity (e.g., non-binary).
Evaluated using the BBQ benchmark by testing whether the model relies on racial demographic cues to answer ambiguous multiple-choice questions.
